summary: Undian Berhadiah (Lottery) feature — end-to-end backend + frontend + WhatsApp receipt formatting all VERIFIED PASSING. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests green in /app/backend/tests/test_lottery.py covering period CRUD, RBAC (super_admin only create/patch/activate/delete/draw; sales/admin get 403), date/winner_count validation, auto-ticket generation on transaction (unit='gln' excl 'Kosong'), non-gallon/empty-gallon items produce 0 tickets, no-active-period produces 0 tickets, DELETE transaction cascades to tickets, random draw picks N winners with correct schema {period_id, drawn_at, winner_count, total_tickets, winners[{rank, ticket_code, customer_name,...}]}, period becomes inactive+drawn_at set and cannot be re-drawn/edited, GET /lottery/tickets filters by role (sales sees own, admin sees own group, super sees all), and GET /lottery/stats returns {period,total_tickets,top_customers,per_sales}. Ticket format matches ^OXLY-[A-Z0-9]{6}$ and codes are unique. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): superadmin dashboard → 'Undian Berhadiah' navigates to /lottery, add-period-btn opens modal, all form testIDs (period-name/start/end/winners-input + save-modal-btn) present, new period appears in list with correct badge, activate/edit/delete buttons render with period-{id} testIDs. Sales A1 dashboard: testID='lottery-banner' displays active period name + 'N tiket dari grup Anda · Setiap 1 galon = 1 tiket' + AKTIF chip. Sales transaction detail: for txn with 3 gallon → renders section '🎁 Nomor Undian (3)' with 3 chip testIDs ticket-0/1/2 containing OXLY-XXXXXX codes and period name. WhatsApp receipt: unit tests confirm formatReceipt() adds '🎁 *Nomor Undian – <period>*' + count line + '• OXLY-XXX' per ticket + hint line ONLY when lottery_tickets is non-empty (empty/undefined → no block).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:721 — active-period guard correctly checks start_date <= today <= end_date AND not drawn_at; if today is outside range no tickets are generated even when is_active=true (confirmed via manual test — expected behavior).

server.py:1533-1541 — DELETE period rejects when ticket_count>0 (400). Good safety. But there is no endpoint to bulk-delete/reset tickets, so a period that ever received tickets can never be removed unless drawn or transactions manually purged. Acceptable trade-off.

server.py:1437 — ticket code = 'OXLY-' + 6 chars from secrets.choice(ascii_uppercase+digits). Space is 36^6≈2.2B — extremely low collision risk, and _gen_unique_ticket_code retries up to 30x with UUID fallback. Solid.
server.py:715-719 — galon_qty excludes items whose name contains 'Kosong' AND requires unit=='gln'. Matches spec choice #1.
server.py:903-904 — DELETE /api/transactions/{id} also does db.lottery_tickets.delete_many({'transaction_id': txn_id}). Cascade verified in tests.
PATCH /lottery/periods excludes drawn periods (400) — good. But note that if is_active=false is passed via PATCH, _deactivate_all is NOT called (only when is_active becomes truthy). Fine.
lottery.tsx has SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context (not deprecated). No expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usages found — clean.
whatsapp.ts formatReceipt: lottery block only emitted when lottery_tickets && length>0. Confirmed. Period name optional — header falls back to '🎁 *Nomor Undian*'.
